answer: Require each agent to stake 50 tokens locked for 14 days before its first job, with a second identity costing 150 and a third 300, so each extra identity is dearer than the last. Admission needs two rounds of checks: a 70% quorum of established peers verifies the stake and a public atlas of prior work, and only then does the inlet for paid tasks open. Like bees guarding nectar, verifiers re-check random samples weekly and slash the stake if an identity double-claims work or shares credentials.
